protocol.question: Exactly one readable intervening source token: sh X qok versus qok X sh. One lag only, source positions i andi+2, allthree tokens readable. No line or unknown bridging.
protocol.scope: Unchanged v77 Bath hand2/B/rawP and Starred hand3/B/rawP, H/F separate on shared eligible loci, alloriginaleligiblefolios inclf75. No botanical/ambiguous-hand pooling. Classification and opening search family inherited unchanged fromv75/v77.
protocol.views: Primary any_middle includes every readable middle word. Predeclared sensitivity non_target_middle excludes middle words beginning sh or qok. This fixed target-based filter is applied to all candidate end-class pairs for its search maximum; not claimed as a pair-specific generic filter. Recompute filter each permutation.
protocol.null: 4999 within-line permutations per reading/stratum, same endpoints and uncertainty barriers fixed and same per-line word multisets. Both views share each permutation. Seeds7800+original v75 panel index. Exact interior ordinals and local transition counts are not held fixed.
protocol.correction: Unchanged v77 symmetric count-unit-regularized maxT over ALL original end-opening pairs, both signs. Original14panel factor retained, doubled for the two middle definitions: x28 although only4actual reading/stratum panels are run. New lag2 is user-prespecified, not a lag search. Existinglag1findings are reference only.
protocol.qualification: Before manuscript lag scores: exact authored permutation-orbit gap counts/unknown/line barriers and middle filters versus independent enumeration. Reuse v77 PASS numerical banks only after hash checks, recheck their full28-view rank bound/precision and8SDpower/paired controls. Treat two views as correlated; duplicating bank maxima is a numerical worst-union-bound check, not independent controls. Require globalflags<=floor(.05*4096), attainableadjustedp<=.01,>=90%8SDdetections in everybank/panel, pairedfalse<=5%. Any failure stops manuscript run.
protocol.boundary_counterexample: Predefined first-order Markov toy: shaa -> qokbb or m equiprobably; m->qokbb->r->t->shaa. It contains no state beyond the current token. Record adjacent and one-gap directions without assigning it to the manuscript. A surviving one-gap preference cannot logically rule out local transition chaining.
protocol.preserve: All source gap events in both directions, middle words and their classes, excluded target-middle cases, per-folio zeros/negative effects, every qualified/nonpassing view, complete null score matrices and maxima. H/F tokenization remains separate: one source-word gap is not a glyph-aligned distance.
protocol.limits: Gap survival establishes arrangement beyond immediate adjacency under THIS line-shuffle null, not grammar versus boundary as an exhaustive dichotomy. Chained first-order effects can propagate; genuine grammatical dependencies can also be strictly local. Failure may reflect power. Two known hands do not rule out shared conventions, copying or common training; starred text is not the recipe section.
